title: AI agents for social media: How to use them right now + what you can expect in the future

facts.fact: HubSpot's own research found that one in three marketers are already deploying AI for content creation and data analysis.
facts.quote: Our own research supports this finding, with one in three marketers already

facts.fact: Lyft reported an 87% reduction in average customer service resolution times through all channels after partnering with Anthropic to automate parts of its customer support.
Gartner predicts that by 2029 AI agents will autonomously handle at least 80% of customer service and support interactions, many of them on social channels.
facts.quote: will autonomously handle at least 80% of customer service and support interactions

facts.fact: Thrive Digital Marketing Agency's AI tool detected subtle frustration patterns in a client's customer comments, giving the team a 2-3 week head start to respond before the issue grew.
facts.quote: With a 2-3 week head start, they could respond with support and content before the issue grew.

facts.fact: The article defines agentic AI as an autonomous AI-powered tool that acts on its own within set guidelines rather than only helping with tasks.
facts.quote: an autonomous AI-powered tool that doesn’t just help you with tasks — it acts on its own within set guidelines.

facts.fact: The article was published on October 6, 2026.
Tim Hanson, CMO at Penfriend, says his team now spends 64% less time on process work after using AI for administrative tasks (a self-reported vendor figure).
facts.quote: our teams now spend 64% less time on process work and 42% more time on genuine connection,” said Hanson.

facts.fact: The author recommends manually approving every AI agent post for the first 1-2 months before turning the agent loose.
facts.quote: I’d start by manually approving every post for the first 1-2 months.

facts.fact: The author describes a 30-60 day probationary period after which the AI agent can begin drafting social content.
facts.quote: After that 30-60 day probationary period, let your agent draft social content.

facts.fact: Alan Chen, CEO of DataNumen, says an AI agent suggested waiting one hour before responding to competitor comments on a campaign, which reduced noise around the brand's content.
facts.quote: suggested that we wait an hour before responding so as not to make them more visible.

facts.fact: The author suggests a human editor review each AI-drafted social post, which should take only a few seconds per post.
facts.quote: Ideally, that should be just a few seconds per post, which you can eventually automate once you trust your agent.

facts.fact: HubSpot's Social Media Agent is included in the Marketing Hub Professional plan, which the article lists at $900 per month.
facts.quote: Social Media Agent is included in HubSpot Marketing Hub’s Professional ($900/month) and Enterprise ($3,800/month) plans.

facts.fact: Respondology's Standard plan starts at $1,500 per month, and organizations seeking to scale must contact the company for pricing.
facts.quote: Respondology’s Standard plan starts at $1,500/month, but for any organization looking to scale, you’ll need to contact the company for pricing.

facts.fact: Heyday by Hootsuite requires contacting Hootsuite for custom pricing and is described as aimed at mid-to-large businesses.
facts.quote: You’ll need to reach out to Hootsuite for custom pricing, but it’s really for mid-to-large businesses

facts.fact: Sprinklr AI pricing is custom, and the article notes Sprinklr AI is enterprise-focused.
facts.quote: Custom pricing is available — but remember, Sprinklr AI is enterprise-focused.

facts.fact: Brandwatch with Iris AI offers custom pricing.
Meltwater offers custom pricing for businesses of all sizes.
facts.quote: Custom pricing is available for businesses of all sizes.

facts.fact: The HubSpot Social Media Agent is semi-agentic according to the article, because users must manually approve every post before publishing.
facts.quote: You need to manually approve every post, though the agent will research and draft great posts for you.

facts.fact: Ask Vista is included in all Vista Social plans, starting at $99 per month.
facts.quote: Ask Vista is included in all Vista Social plans, starting at $99/month.
